newsitem.title: POLAND: POLL -Polish consumer confidence rises in July.
newsitem.headline: POLL -Polish consumer confidence rises in July.

text.p: Polish consumer confidence indicators, measured by the Demoskop polling institute for the Rzeczpospolita daily, rose in July after easing in June, Demoskop said on Thursday.
Demoskop's economic climate index hit an all time high of 112 points, up from 108 points in June and propensity to spend rose to 105 points from 99 in the previous month.
The consumer optimism index rose to 108 points from June's 103 points. The Demoskop survey was carried out on July 4-8 among a representative random sample of 993 adult Poles.
